preparations.label: Full bladder
preparations.patient_text: Drink 4 to 6 glasses of water about an hour before your scan, and don't empty your bladder until the scan is done.

preparations.label: Fasting
preparations.patient_text: Don't eat for 6 hours before your scan. You can have small sips of water.

preparations.label: Bowel prep
preparations.patient_text: Follow the bowel preparation the imaging centre gives you. Ask them about it when you book.
